onboarding.title: OpenWinBox — Getting started
onboarding.step1.title: A light organizing layer on your desktop
onboarding.step1.text: OpenWinBox puts your folders in widgets on the desktop: your shortcuts close at hand, without covering the apps you work in.
onboarding.step1.readyOne: You have 1 widget ready on the desktop.
onboarding.step1.readyMany: You have {0} widgets ready on the desktop.
onboarding.step1.none: You don't have any widgets yet; you'll create the first one in the next step.
onboarding.step2.title: Your folders, in widgets
onboarding.step2.text: Each widget shows the contents of a folder. If you add several folders to a widget, they appear as tabs. Double-click an item to open it.
onboarding.step3.title: Show them anytime, hide them anytime
onboarding.step3.text: Press F7 or left-click the OpenWinBox icon in the tray.
onboarding.step3.try: Try it, or continue to the next step.
onboarding.step3.busy: F7 is in use by another app (the original DeskBox?). Close it and restart OpenWinBox.
onboarding.step4.title: Always behind your apps
onboarding.step4.text: Widgets live on the desktop and never cover the window you're working in. You can change this anytime in Settings.

settings.hotkeyAdmin.title: Why don't keyboard shortcuts always respond?
settings.hotkeyAdmin.message: If the active window runs as administrator (for example, Task Manager), Windows blocks global shortcuts. This is a Windows limitation.
